baseline_models.focus_anchor: حمٓ as a standalone ayah with two named letters and no rooted morphemes
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus presents a pronounceable and visible unit while withholding ordinary lexical predication. Its available force is therefore carried by discrete sound, script, compression, and placement rather than by a recoverable focus-root meaning.

changed_reading.before: A short expression presumed to behave like an ordinary rooted word.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately rootless two-letter utterance whose form is available while its lexical expansion remains unassigned.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The complete first ayah consists only of حمٓ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Its ayah boundary and opening position let the compact pair function as a threshold event: it starts reception before supplying a proposition.

changed_reading.before: An isolated token waiting to be decoded internally.
changed_reading.after: An opening act whose position and delivery may matter independently of any expansion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early revelation cue and the closing contrast among intelligible speech, hidden imparting, and a screening barrier turn the opener's opacity into a performed channel condition. حمٓ is perceptibly delivered but lexically withheld, like a signal crossing a veil rather than a failed word.

activation_trace.role: Signal and gesture supply the non-propositional mode that the immediately following revelation verb assigns to the rootless opening.
Intelligible speech joining speakers supplies the contrast against which the delivered but unparsed letters become a distinct communication mode.
Hidden imparting permits communicated knowledge to be present even when ordinary lexical disclosure is absent.
A screening barrier gives the opacity a functional role: the form arrives while full semantic access remains behind a veil.

structural_cues: 42:2 extends the opening with a second rootless letter cluster before any rooted clause appears.
42:3 begins with كذلك and a revelation verb, while 42:51 explicitly places revelation and veil beside divine speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rootless delivery followed by revelation and later names indirect speech channels; I infer that the placement enacts mediated disclosure. A live alternative is that حمٓ only marks the boundary and does not imitate the channel.

changed_reading.before: Opaque initials whose opacity is merely a deficit of interpretation.
changed_reading.after: An enacted veiled signal: fully delivered as sound and script while withholding ordinary lexical content.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact focus sequence ح-م becomes an expandable consonantal kernel. Appending dal yields the praise root, while prefixing ra yields the mercy root; 42:5 presents praise then mercy, and 42:28 presents mercy then praise. The reversal makes the two completions reciprocal without claiming that حمٓ lexically equals either one.

activation_trace.role: Praise as the opposite of blame completes the focus pair outward by adding dal and opens the first half of the reciprocal sequence.
Mercy and tenderness complete the same pair from the other side by adding ra and close the first sequence.
Mercy and tenderness now occur first, reversing the earlier order around the shared focus sequence.
Praise now closes the reversed pair, making the two consonantal completions answer one another.

structural_cues: حمٓ supplies exactly the adjacent consonants shared by ح م د initially and ر ح م finally.
The two roots co-occur in opposite orders at 42:5 and 42:28.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact consonantal containment and reversed co-occurrence; I infer that reciprocal completion gives the rootless pair an anticipatory function. The materially live alternative is accidental overlap among common consonants, so this is not an acronym claim.

changed_reading.before: A closed opaque pair with no internal semantic motion.
changed_reading.after: An open consonantal kernel held between praise and mercy, completed from opposite sides and in reciprocal order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The second rootless ayah gives حمٓ a formally distinct mate, and the surah's later pairing branch makes relation itself functional. The two-letter and three-letter clusters form a paired threshold whose difference is preserved rather than merged.

activation_trace.role: Making one thing a mate to another turns the adjacent rootless clusters into a relational opening rather than two self-sufficient codes.
A mate joined to its counterpart reinforces paired identity while allowing each opening cluster to retain its own size and cadence.

structural_cues: 42:1 and 42:2 are consecutive complete ayat, both rootless and made only of named letters.
حمٓ has two units and عٓسٓقٓ has three, so pairing does not require formal sameness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate adjacency and repeated pairing language; I infer a two-part gate whose members gain force relationally. The live alternative is that the clusters are independent opening markers.

changed_reading.before: A standalone cipher expected to contain its whole value by itself.
changed_reading.after: The first member of an unequal paired opening, heard in cadence and contrast with عٓسٓقٓ.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, revelation is recited, letters are organized as writing, and the closing revelation becomes light that guides to a path. This medium progression lets حمٓ function as a minimal carrier whose force unfolds through recitation, inscription, illumination, and orientation rather than through acronym expansion.

activation_trace.role: Reading and recitation make the focus letters an audible textual event, not merely silent graphic marks.
Writing and inscription connect revelation to the visible letter material from which the focus ayah is made.
The ordering of letters into a written object supplies the next material scale beyond the opener's bare pair.
Illumination changes textual delivery into perceptual disclosure without requiring a lexical expansion of حمٓ.
Gentle indication toward a way assigns the disclosed material an orienting function.
The straight path is the functional destination of the sequence from mark to recitation to light and guidance.

structural_cues: 42:7 explicitly joins revelation with an Arabic recitation.
42:52 sequences revelation, spirit, book, light, guidance, and path near the surah's close, answering the bare marks at its opening.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the medium terms and their closing sequence; I infer that the first rootless marks anticipate a transformation from carrier to orientation. A live alternative is that the opener is independent of this progression and only precedes it.

changed_reading.before: Inert initials whose value depends on discovering substituted words.
changed_reading.after: A minimal textual carrier whose value emerges as it is recited, inscribed, illuminated, and made directional.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links revelation and consultation through their separate gesture branches. It remains anchored in حمٓ as an underdetermined visible and audible sign, but it does not show that the letters historically encode consultation; downstream prose should present only a shared reception mechanism.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus communicates a bounded sign without supplying a lexical proposition.

activation_trace.role: Signal and gesture cast the rootless pair as a communicative indication rather than a private lexical statement.
Gesture and sensory indication echo the revelation branch and carry the opaque sign into a shared field of reception.
Extracting judgment through reciprocal review supplies a communal way to work with a sign whose meaning is not privately self-evident.

changed_reading.before: A private cipher to be solved by a single decoder.
changed_reading.after: A revelation-shaped gesture whose underdetermination can solicit shared, revisable reception.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain activation moves from reproductive barrenness to obscure speech, so it is deliberately form-distant. It remains anchored in the focus ayah's lack of rooted lexical yield and is sharpened by the next ayah's speech construction; downstream prose should call it an analogy for lexical nonproduction, not the meaning of حمٓ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: حمٓ is utterable but produces no ordinary rooted word within the focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: Obscure barren speech supplies the analogy of an utterance that does not generate ordinary lexical offspring.
An intelligible word or expression provides the immediate contrast that makes the focus pair's lexical nonproduction visible.

changed_reading.before: A word whose hidden lexical product has not yet been found.
changed_reading.after: An intentionally nonproductive utterance whose failure to become an ordinary word redirects attention to mode, sound, and placement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the most branch-distant activation: the source surface belongs to the QAC sky root, while a non-dominant mapped inventory contains the exact حم sequence inside a fixed branch phrase. The formal echo is packet-grounded and focus-anchored, but it licenses neither derivation nor a stable semantic gloss; downstream prose should mark it as resonance only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The exact written and sounded sequence حم is the entire focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant split-root branch contains the exact focus sequence as phrase material, supplying a literal graphic and phonic echo across unrelated lexical material.

changed_reading.before: A sound-shape isolated from every branch inventory in the surah.
changed_reading.after: A minimal sound-shape that can resonate inside remote branch material without thereby acquiring that branch's etymology or meaning.

strongest_changes: The rootless opener becomes a performed veiled signal when the opening revelation cue is read with the closing speech, revelation, and barrier sequence.
The exact ح-م pair becomes a reciprocal kernel for praise and mercy through the reversed ح م د / ر ح م ordering at 42:5 and 42:28.
The second rootless ayah and later pairing cues make حمٓ the first member of a relational opening rather than a self-contained cipher.
The whole-surah movement through recitation, writing, light, guidance, and path recasts the letters as a minimal carrier that becomes orientation.
summary.what_was_special: Because the focus has no rooted morphemes, the live activations attach to exact consonantal shape, rootless construction, sound-script duality, and opening placement. Whole-surah recurrence then supplies reciprocal completion, mediated disclosure, paired form, and medium transformation without forcing one lexical solution.
remaining_uncertainties: No focus-root inventory can adjudicate a lexical expansion, and none has been assigned.
The praise-mercy consonantal reciprocity is exact and repeated but could still be emergent rather than intentional.
The pairing model depends on treating 42:1-2 as one formal gate rather than independent markers.
The consultation, barren-speech, and split-root echoes remain exploratory and require explicit qualification.
